news.title: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done
news.summary: 'We see real risks the Fed will deliver another rate hike in two weeks' time,' one Fedwatcher warns

news.title: U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting
news.summary: The exchange comes as U.S. debt exceeds $40 trillion and 10-year Treasury yields remain above 5%, intensifying scrutiny of the fiscal outlook.

news.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
news.summary: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

news.title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration
news.summary: European trade commissioner Maroš Sefčovič met with Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing last week.

news.title: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
news.summary: The U.K. is grappling with a cost-of-living crisis sparked by sticky inflation and surging energy costs.

news.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
news.summary: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.

news.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
news.summary: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

news.title: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
news.summary: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.6% in September on a monthly basis and 3.6% from a year ago, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

news.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
news.summary: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

news.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
news.summary: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.

news.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
news.summary: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

news.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
news.summary: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

news.title: Nobel prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
news.summary: The U.S. economists were awarded for work that underpins the models used by central banks and governments to stabilize the economy.

news.title: India’s retail inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, above estimates
news.summary: India inflations jumps for the 11-straight month, raising prospects of a further interest rate hike

news.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
news.summary: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

news.title: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor
news.summary: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.

news.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
news.summary: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.

news.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
news.summary: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.

news.title: ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies
news.summary: Research links ICE enforcement surges to lasting declines in local spending, foot traffic and jobs. In Minneapolis, businesses are still recovering.
